forum.title: Is dual-rank ddr3l supported on the mp2? Conflicting info in 4 different places.
forum.category: STM32 MPUs Products and hardware related
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@gabriel0,

There is no conflict with STM32MP2: we only support **single-rank** with DDR3L, so **dual-rank is not possible**.

However, it is absolutely possible to find **DDR3L 1 GB single-rank** devices.

Here is a reference for a DDR3L that is documented on the ST Wiki <https://wiki.st.com/stm32mpu/wiki/Validated_DRAM_on_STM32_MPU_portfolio#STM32MP2->

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/47e519a2-c402-4f1c-a3fe-f146e50c13c3.png)

and another one from the same manufacturer you mentioned earlier (ISSI). As you can see in the screenshot, there are indeed two references: one for **dual-rank** and one for **single-rank**. You must choose the **single-rank** version.

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/879e0612-a7d9-44bf-bad7-86c9bcf5f3ba.png)

Best Regards,

Zakaria
forum.content_text:
I'm using the mp215 with ddr3l (x16) and an ISSI dram ic that is 8Gb (1 gigabyte) which means it's a dual rank configuration compared to a more typical half gigabyte. As far as im aware all 1GB ddr3 dram ic's are dual rank.

In AN5723 6.1 Note it says "**8 Gbit DDR3 defined by JEDEC is uncommon. Practically, DDR3L density is limited to 4 Gbits (max = 1 Gbyte in total). Single rank only is required.** ".

[an5723 link](https://www.st.com/resource/en/application_note/an5723-guidelines-for-ddr-configuration-on-stm32mp2-mpus-stmicroelectronics.pdf)

As far as I understand it it says it's not possible. However this is an older AN and i think it's for the mp25 series only (im using the mp21).

However in the ST Wiki "How to setup the DDR configuration" section 5 the exact opposite is implied. This whole section repeatedly describes a "concrete example" of swapping the swapping the mp215-dk's lpddr4 out with a 1GB ddr3 ic. Also using a theoretical dtsi called "*stm32mp21-ddr3-1x8Gbits-1x16bits-800MHz.dtsi*" and define "DDR\_MEM\_SIZE 0x40000000" which is 1GB. So this is conflicting info because i dont see how 1gb ddr3 is possible if it isn't dual rank.

<https://wiki.st.com/stm32mpu/wiki/How_to_setup_the_DDR_configuration#STM32MP2_series>

However another conflict is in cubemx. I have 16 bit ddr3 set for the DDR\_CTRL\_PHY config. And i even have Density set to 8Gb implying dual rank. but the greyed out "user input basic" option has NUMRANK\_DFI0 set to 1 and it can't be changed. so i don't know how im even supposed to generate a valid dtsi for my case.

![gabriel0_0-1778218908356.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/72b829e1-4fda-d078-0a42-13163d7a51e3.png "gabriel0_0-1778218908356.png")

Another conflict on top of that is the mp21 control signals DDR\_A2 and DDR\_A6 pins are CS\_N0 and CS\_N1. Those are chip select pins ranks. Once again implying it is possible. So which is it? is it supported or not and if it is how do i set it as dual rank in cubemx.

To reiterate on what st resources say about dual rank ddr3.

- AN5723 says it's not possible

- Wiki says it is.

-Cubemx implies it's not.

-Routing pins available implies it is.
